column1: # LoRa node partition table (Heltec V3 8 MB / V4 16 MB).
# Same NVS and app offsets as the IDF default single-app table
# NVS provisioning survives and the flasher's offsets don't change; the app
# partition grows from 1 MiB to 3 MiB to fit the combined node image.
# Frame boot counter (lora_provision.c). Kept after the app so flashing a
# merged image never overwrites it; only a full chip erase resets it.
